grammar.0.title: Structure of a letter / email
grammar.0.note: In a formal email always use Sie and a capital Sie/Ihr.
grammar.0.rows.2.1: a comma, then a lowercase letter
grammar.0.rows.2.2: a comma, then a lowercase letter
grammar.1.title: Separable verb + modal
grammar.1.intro: In a normal sentence the separable verb splits. With a modal it stays whole and goes to the end.
grammar.2.title: bitte and danke — don't skimp on them in writing
grammar.2.text: Politeness matters a lot in emails: „vielen Dank für …“ (thank you very much for …), „Bitte antworte …“ (please reply …). Even when you say no, thank them first, then say leider.
